children: Sensex Today | Stock Market Live Updates:

Today is the monthly expiry of all NSE contracts. The Nifty 50 is nearly at the same levels at which it closed the September series as of Monday. The index snapped a four-day losing streak on Monday and continued with Friday's trend of a steep initial fall, followed by a sharper recovery.

However, some buying from lower levels in Midcaps and Smallcaps is something that will give bulls greater comfort. Today's session will bring with itself its fair share of volatility with the VIX continuing to remain at elevated levels. For the Nifty, 22,800 is the level to watch on the upside, as a sustained move above that could take the index back towards the 23,000 mark.

Supports down are harder to predict considering the broad range the index has traded in over Friday and Monday. The bulls though, would want that the intraday lows of sub-22,400 are not broken. The Nifty Bank underperformed the Nifty on Monday but did recover from the lows.

title: Sensex Today | Stock Market Live Updates: Nifty aims to sustain recovery on monthly expiry with 22,800-23,000 in sight
